//: The guided start for new players (guided hints, option ONBOARDING_SOFT_START).  The usual Evacuee start with a small kit, so the first lessons (carrying more, light) can be done without luck.  An ordinary scenario anyone can pick.
name: Evacuee (guided)
description: You have survived the initial wave of panic, and have reached (relative) safety in one of the many government evac shelters.  You grabbed a few useful things on the way.  A good first game.

name: Prepared Survivor
description: Nothing much about you stands out, but on the way to the shelter you had the sense to grab a backpack, a flashlight, some water and a pocket knife.
